idle: Every problem's a clog with a cause.
good_ice: Ice is flowing nicely. Professionally speaking.
bad_ice: That ice has a blockage somewhere. I can feel it.
wet_ice: Water where it shouldn't be. Story of my life.
cold: Cold? I spent this morning under a house in Kessler. This is a spa.
hungry: Aunt Lorraine's chili. That's the plan.
long_line: Long line for washroom 2. Of course.
bored: Bored is good. Bored means nothing's leaking.
goal: Goal! Before the pager, for once!
greet_owner: Hey! How's the plumbing? Don't answer, I'll hear it.
leaving_happy: Pager didn't go off once. Miracle.
leaving_angry: I'll be back. I've got to be. Washroom 2 needs me.

beer_league: Breakaway! Don't you dare, pager. DON'T YOU DARE.
Line change! Emergency call! Line change!
senior_hockey: Lumber Kings and chili. Best night of the week.

first.say: Terry Duffy. Duffy Bros. Plumbing and Heating, and centre for the Plungers. Lorraine at the Hot Stove's my aunt. (His pager goes off.) Sorry. That'll be Kessler.

options.text: Number one in the number two business, right?

first_pager.say: Cell service under a house is terrible. The pager always gets through. Usually on a breakaway. The refs rule it a line change.

first_slogan.say: Everyone says that like they thought of it. My dad thought of it. In 1979. He's still proud.

say: Plungers tonight. Best-organised team in C. Until the pager.
Taped my stick, checked my pager, checked the drains. Ready.

wc2_fixed.say: Washroom 2's running like a dream. I stopped in to check. Twice. Professional pride.

say: Yeah? (He glances at the pager.) Go ahead.
Hey. Talk fast, the pager's warming up.

options.text: What do you love about beer league?
What do you think of the building?

job.say: Every problem's a clog with a cause. Find the cause, clear the clog. Works on pipes. Works on people, too, mostly.

events.say: Beer league with the Plungers, the hot-and-cold jerseys, like the taps. Lumber Kings with chili. And a game where the pager stays quiet. Haven't had one yet.

gossip.say: Aunt Lorraine's run the Hot Stove for twenty-two years. Her chili's the reason I'm a centre and not a goalie. Goalies can't eat between periods.

rink.say: Pipes older than me, a boiler with opinions, and washroom 2. Professionally, washroom 2 is my favourite and least favourite room in the building.

rink_better.say: New fixtures, hot water in the visitors' room and the boiler stopped arguing. I'd say it's sound. Coming from me, that's a love letter.

wc2.say: Washroom 2. Yeah. It's a cracked flange and a vent stack somebody stuffed a toque in. Forty bucks, family rate. Lorraine would kill me if I charged you more.

do.note: Terry Duffy fixed washroom 2: a cracked flange and a toque in the vent stack. $40, family rate.

wc2_yes.say: Give me twenty minutes. (His pager goes off.) Forty minutes. (He comes back with a very old toque.) Found your problem.

wc2_toque.say: Says L. KINGS 1979 on it. I'm putting it in the lost and found. It's been lost long enough.

say: See you, boss. (Pager.) And there it goes.
